suggested_changes.reasoning: Reducing the dropout rate will likely reduce underfitting and help the model to learn more from the data. Lowering the learning rate and increasing the number of epochs can provide more opportunity for the model to learn from the imbalanced data. Increasing the gamma value in the FocalLoss can help the model focus more on hard, misclassified examples. Implementing threshold optimization based on the f1_score will improve the balance between precision and recall. More aggressive data augmentation for the rare classes can help to balance the dataset and provide more varied examples for the model to learn from.
